combo_label: In the Bathroom × Herbs & Spices × Ghosts & Hauntings

entries.clue: Knobbly underground stem, hot to the tongue, grated into a stir-fry or a biscuit
Quietly frightening in the way an empty corridor can be.
Tall hollow plant whose stalks are candied bright green to decorate a trifle
Morning armpit armour, rolled or sprayed on
Filmy white emanation of the darkened seance room, often exposed as cheesecloth.
Maddening midnight metronome from a spout never quite shut
Day before, in the calendar of feasts; All Hallows' is the ghostly one
Slippery bar that leaps from wet hands like a fish
Tangy dark-crimson powder from a Levantine shrub, dusted over houmous
Splinter of the True Cross or a finger-bone in a jewelled box, venerated
What a monk wears daily and a bather wears briefly
To warm wine with sugar and whole seasonings for a cold winter night
Wailing woman of Irish legend whose cry means a death is coming.
